headline: Bruins host Flyers for Saturday afternoon clash at the Garden
morning_brew: It is a Saturday in the Hub and I have one thing on my mind, getting down to the Garden for this afternoon's puck drop against Philadelphia. We are back on the ice at one and I am praying for a cleaner effort than we have seen in spots this season. The Flyers are always a chippy bunch, and honestly, after spending the last few days wallowing in Red Sox offseason talk, I am just ready to watch some real hockey violence instead of reading about front-office posturing.

Speaking of the Red Sox, the silence from the front office since Alex Cora confirmed he is stepping away has been deafening. My neighbor Rick has been pacing his driveway for forty-eight hours, fully convinced the team is about to trade for the entire league, but I think we are just in for a long winter of misery and rumors. It is the classic Boston baseball hangover, and while the sting of an early exit has faded, the uncertainty about what 2027 looks like is already grating on my nerves like a stalled train on the Red Line.

As for the gridiron, the Patriots have a massive Sunday ahead of them against the Raiders. Losing starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis is a brutal blow that makes me want to cover my eyes, but hearing Rhamondre Stevenson is expected to suit up at least gives us a puncher's chance on the ground. We need a win to keep the season from slipping into the abyss, and if our defense can hold the line despite the walking wounded, maybe we can steal one at Gillette.

news_digest.headline: RB Rhamondre Stevenson expected to play Sunday vs. Raiders
news_digest.dans_take: Finally some good news, I was starting to think our entire roster was held together by duct tape and prayers.

news_digest.headline: Patriots won't have starting CBs Christian Gonzalez, Carlton Davis
news_digest.dans_take: Our secondary is gonna be tested big time, hope they brought their track shoes to keep up.
